## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean
- [ ] Tests added beside the code, in the module's own `mod tests`
- [ ] No new dependency (or: why one is unavoidable, below)
- [ ] Default behaviour is unchanged — anything new is behind a flag
- [ ] Comments explain *why*; any standard implemented is cited
